title: KramakWorkItemState
description: Tracks the lifecycle state of a single work item shard (used for parallel execution)

work_item_id.description: Identifier of the work item shard (e.g. WI-001, WI-1001)

worktree_path.description: Filesystem path to isolated git worktree if executed in parallel, or null

holder.description: Identifier of the worker agent holding the execution lock

acquired_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the shard lock was acquired

lock.description: Execution lock preventing concurrent double-execution of the shard

state_hash.description: State hash for oscillation detection by circuit breaker

merge_status.description: Status of work item branch in the serialized merge queue

status.description: Lifecycle execution status of the work item shard
